fills.fill: When the earth of darkness rose up
fills.notes: The sequence describes the initial stirring of the dark land before the later ‘gushing’ of elements in ¶3. The oldest substrate typically begins with the uprising/stirring of the Dark Earth as a mass.
‘It moved it’ points to an external stimulus; in the cosmological logic Darkness is set in motion upon sensing/encountering the opposed region.
Those ‘in the … of the earth of darkness’ are its internal districts/worlds; ‘regions’ matches the impersonal cosmographic register.
The clause ends ‘first part.’ This needs a brief demonstrative/labeling link: ‘this is the first part.’
The gushing occurs because the substance had no vent/exit; this matches the pressure-to-efflux correspondential logic used to introduce the five elements of Death.
The elements ‘gushed and streamed up’ from below; ‘depth’ is the standard cosmological source-location for the Dark Earth’s efflux.
Refers back to the Dark Earth as source of the five death-elements.
Second reference to the same source; the text doubles the causal statement in a formulaic way.
Bridges to the ‘second time’ phase; simple temporal connective suits the schematic enumerations.
‘They were sculpted … those in which death was established’ requires the notion of formation/figuration from elemental efflux into structured vessels.
Death becomes ‘established’ in the constructed domains; ‘worlds’ anticipates ¶4–¶5’s ‘five worlds’.
‘Evil fruits’ in the five trees implies a maturation/producing action; ‘ripened’ keeps the botanical correspondence without moralizing.
The sentence already says ‘ten parts, five male parts and five female …’; the missing word is the repeated noun completing the parallelism.
Darkness’ ‘spirit and its breath’ is a standard pair: internal animating principle (spirit) and its proceeding activity (breath), which ‘nourished’ the elements.
Completes ‘they nourished the five elements …’; the nourishment applies to the elements resident within the dark realm.
Parallelism: as spirit/breath ‘nourished’ the five elements, so the ten parts (male/female) ‘nourish’ fire and lust in the flesh.
Fire and lust are not merely present but ignited/activated ‘in’ the flesh by the male/female parts yoked together.
‘This is … of the darkness’ requires an abstract heading-word; ‘mystery’ matches the technical, non-devotional usage continued in ¶7 (‘Alongside the mystery…’).
Maintains the repeated formula ‘were established against the First Man’ by stating the emergence/setting of these twelve parts in the same hostile orientation.
Needed to make a complete identification: ‘The twelve parts are the twelve spirits of error…’

fills.fill: and were established against the First Man
fills.notes: Restores the closing hostile function, matching the refrain in ¶6–¶7 and keeping the impersonal cosmological cadence.

assessment: Most gaps are recoverable because the chapter is a schematic enumeration (first part/second time/fourth part/fifth time) with repeated formulae (‘five worlds’, ‘death was established’, ‘against the First Man’). Exact particles are occasionally uncertain, but the correspondential structure constrains the main missing nouns and verbs (outlet/depth, formation into worlds, nourishment/kindling, and the identification of the twelve parts with zodiacal spirits of error).
